metric_caveats.false_reassurance_proxy: A resolved must-detect test with no returned finding. It measures a dangerous system behavior, but is not a clinically adjudicated population rate.
metric_caveats.source_url_coverage: Presence of a URL is not citation precision. Citation precision requires a human judgment that the cited passage supports the displayed claim.
metric_caveats.unsupported: Unsupported cases are excluded from conditional performance rates and reported separately.
